capability_definitions.INTEGRATED_AND_TESTED: the released configuration emits BOQ lines of the family from tested code, and no verifier-confirmed open defect or unwired verified correction touches that path
capability_definitions.PARTIAL: the released configuration emits lines (or a run file) of the family, but part of the scope is missing, always held on a known input, or a verifier-confirmed defect / unwired verified correction is open
capability_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_INTEGRATED: merged, tested code measures the family, but only an opt-in method or a standalone piece reads it; the released configuration does not
capability_definitions.EXPERIMENTAL: research code only (round / P7757 engines), read by no method
capability_definitions.BLOCKED_BY_SOURCE: needs documents the engine does not read
